race.title: Omoda And Jaecoo Race To Victory Mares' Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: STRONG RUN is still low mileage in handicaps and makes appeal quickly reverted to the smaller obstacles after a luckless chase debut. Easy To Follow is also respected on her comeback, whilst Party Vibes rates as an interesting candidate from her lower hurdles mark. STRONG RUN EASY TO FOLLOW (IRE) PARTY VIBES (IRE)
